summary: Every requirement R1-R5 is delivered by a phase and R6/R7 are operator keystrokes by the plan's own design; all sixteen rulings are carried out, and the only two things the plan assigns outside a phase are assigned there by the plan itself (the doc phase corrects `namespace: argocd` across the argo-cd doc set, and recording the Keycloak client for Trello #68, now an explicit A2 keystroke). I read the artefacts rather than the done-records: the chart's register values, both ApplicationSet bodies (four hook parameters, requeueAfterSeconds: 0, missingkey=error, finalizer, shared templatePatch), the AppProject, the hook ClusterRole, all 22 credential keys against slice 007's inventory, and ProofDeploy's chart/terraform/config — every build-side criterion (V01-V10, V19, V28-V30) has implementing work I could point at, and V11-V27 are the A.5 proof items the plan states are outcome-level acceptance run after the operator's bootstrap, not build work. Nothing downstream depends on an unproduced thing: the relay tag 2485, homelab-shared 0.2.0 and P3's ApplicationSets all exist. I fixed the two comment-only residues in session (B13's wrong TLS reason on the :80 leg and B8's wrong repo for the ESO helper) as ArgoCDDeploy 415a0c4, gate unmoved at 68 objects; and reconciled the close-out — struck B4 as resolved by P2 and P4, struck B8/B13 as fixed, folded S10 into A1 and A4 after re-checking that both remotes are still empty, extended A2 with the #68 record, and added S13 for an untracked scratch dump left in /work/Ansible.
